phase0.branch_deviation: Prompt requested audit/mvp-readiness-<sha>. The Arena harness pins this session to arena/01a0fac4-tamirkar; work on any other branch would not be attributable to the session. All work is on arena/01a0fac4-tamirkar.

mvp_definition.product: Oosta (اوستا) — Persian-first Android appliance-repair marketplace: diagnosis before price, device passport, 15% escrow, KYC-gated technicians.

primary_user_journeys.name: LOGIN
primary_user_journeys.action: Enters Iranian mobile, receives OTP by SMS, verifies it

primary_user_journeys.name: TRIAGE
primary_user_journeys.expected: Preliminary AI diagnosis or explicit human-support fallback; never a binding price

primary_user_journeys.name: PASSPORT
primary_user_journeys.action: Registers a device and reviews its repair history
primary_user_journeys.expected: Durable identity + chronological repair history that survives reinstall

primary_user_journeys.name: BOOK
primary_user_journeys.action: Customer creates order; approved technician sends immutable quote; customer accepts
primary_user_journeys.expected: Quote accepted, siblings superseded, order -> awaiting_payment

primary_user_journeys.name: PAY
primary_user_journeys.action: Pays the accepted quote through Zarinpal
primary_user_journeys.expected: Balanced ledger capture (debit gateway_clearing, credit technician_payable 85%, credit escrow_liability 15%) + escrow_holds row (30d)

primary_user_journeys.name: RELEASE
primary_user_journeys.action: Runs escrow release for due holds
primary_user_journeys.expected: Idempotent, balanced ledger release; duplicate run changes ledger exactly once

primary_user_journeys.name: GUILD
primary_user_journeys.action: Applies, submits KYC, receives human review decision
primary_user_journeys.expected: verification_status unsubmitted->submitted->approved; only approved technicians may quote or be paid

in_scope: Server-side AI gateway with PII redaction
Zarinpal payment capture + double-entry ledger + escrow
Server feature flags published to client
out_of_scope: Graphical admin console (KYC decisions are API-only)
Object storage for KYC documents and job evidence (references + SHA-256 only)
